review: Viewed all nine candidates in the canonical four-side and three-quarter sheet.

selected.hangar_c: Segmented curved roof, bronze clerestory bands and external rib grid most closely preserve the Atlas shell; both ends remain open for the drive-through sector.
selected.tower_c: Faceted panel pedestal and explicit mullions match the reference taper and observation cabin better than stacked boxes.
selected.wedge_c: Open trusses, panel seams and rail caps preserve the reference construction in side and rear views.

verifier: All three selected new props clean; 7/9 candidates clean. Reused ramp retains its documented featureless-face heuristic warnings.
concept_limit: Atlas target depicts a different sports car and a straight launch ramp. The preserved Roadster and original overhanging ramp remain the geometric authority.
